thread:
elaine (People Ops): Heads up — planning a Manager Appreciation lunchbox drop next Fri. 60 physical boxes across SF/NYC/LON/SEA/TOR + 20 remote e-gifts. Need: final dietary counts, volunteers for packing, and invoice/PO flow. Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

ben (Catering): I can cater. Menu options: omnivore / vegan / gluten-free. Quote: $18/box delivered. That includes hot-pack, sandwich/salad, drink, small dessert.

elaine (People Ops): Our internal target was $15/box. Can we hit that by trimming something? Also need 30 spot-award cards inserted into random boxes.

raja (Finance): We can approve $18 if this is coded to GL 4-215 (manager recognition). Need vendor invoice + PO by EOD Wed to make payroll cutoff.

ben (Catering): If we swap dessert to a granola bar we drop to $14.50. I'll upload menu pdf + photos to the sheet.

nana (Facilities): (edited) We have 30 printed manager cards in stock; placing print job for additional 40 now — ETA Wed noon. Please confirm final card wording.

kyle (Managers Guild): I'll export recipient CSV and include dietary flags by Tue noon. Please confirm we include contractors? We usually exclude ICs unless nominated.

elaine (People Ops): Exclude ICs unless manager nominated. Wording for card: "Thanks for leading with heart — Redwood appreciates you." Any edits?

raja (Finance): Wording fine. Also add internal line on invoice: "Charge to GL 4-215; keep receipts for audit".

tasha (People Ops): Volunteers: I can do packing Thurs 4
02pm at SF kitchen. Need 5 more packers. Who can help? @here

ben (Catering): Packing-friendly boxes ready. Recommend packing station layout: 2x tables, label printer, sanitizer.

frank (Sales): I can help Thurs.

kyle (Managers Guild): I'll send 2 volunteers from managers guild.

invoice-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Upload vendor invoice for Manager Lunchboxes" due Wed 17:00 UTC.

raja (Finance): Once invoice is in the sheet I can raise PO. Also add vendor tax ID to the vendor tab.

elaine (People Ops): Noted. I'll attach vendor tax ID and contract to the sheet, and update counts after kyle's CSV. Remote gift cards set at $12 each. If final cost > $1,800 finance will sign off.

ben (Catering): I'll prep a sample box pic and updated pricing before EOD.

elaine (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll post a final checklist tomorrow AM: packing volunteers, final menu, invoice link, and the packing slip message: "A small thanks for your leadership — drop a shoutout in #gratitude" :heart:
